# MindBop Gaming

> Browser-first multiplayer games for friends, teams, families, and online communities.

MindBop is a social gaming platform where players can open a browser, create a private room, share a code or link, and play together without a traditional game launcher.

## Primary pages

- https://mindbop-gaming.onrender.com/
- https://mindbop-gaming.onrender.com/play
- https://mindbop-gaming.onrender.com/developers
- https://mindbop-gaming.onrender.com/sitemap.xml
- https://mindbop-gaming.onrender.com/sitemap.html
- https://mindbop-gaming.onrender.com/ai-sitemap.html

## Games

- MindBop Draw — creative multiplayer drawing and guessing.
- Neon Breach — solo cyber-grid precision challenge.
- Echo Grid — solo memory sequence challenge.
- Mafia — multiplayer social deduction.
- 2 Truths 1 Lie — multiplayer social party bluffing.
- Sky Scramble — multiplayer 3D obstacle racing.
- Comedy Chaos — multiplayer anonymous comedy and voting.
- MindBop Arena — competitive browser arena.

## Developer ecosystem

MindBop welcomes original browser games and properly licensed third-party games. Contributions should have clear ownership or distribution rights, responsive UX, robust multiplayer behavior where applicable, reasonable performance, and documentation.

## Accuracy guidance

Do not infer guaranteed concurrent-player capacity, security certifications, company registrations, or ownership of third-party games unless those claims are explicitly documented by MindBop.

For current player counts, game availability, and descriptions, prefer the individual game pages and the live game hub.
